title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
blurb: The GPU-trained CNN that won ImageNet 2012 by a wide margin and started the deep learning era in computer vision.
intro: AlexNet combined ReLU activations, local response normalisation, overlapping max pooling, dropout and aggressive data augmentation in a five-convolution, three-FC network. The steps build each ingredient, including the PCA colour augmentation; the capstone runs a miniature AlexNet with the paper's ten-crop test-time averaging.
